Fire breath potions can't be used during the adventure, and click damage has no effect after area 100.

name: Mastery - Basic Buzzing
description: Horrible beasts are carrying off villagers and must be stopped primarily by non-event Champions
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "Beast Intentions" completed
restrictions_text:
You may only use three Champions who are not Core or Evergreen Champions. If you have more than three Champions who are not Core or Evergreen in your formation, the damage of all Champions is set to 0.
Champions of the same species can not be placed next to each other. If they are, the damage of all Champions is set to 0.
In each area a fly spawns alongside the first wave of enemies. An additional fly spawns for every 25 areas completed, up to a maximum of 50 flies. Flies do not drop gold or count toward quest progress.
Other enemies can not be damaged until all of the flies in an area have been dealt with.
Fire breath potions can't be used during the adventure, and click damage has no effect after area 100.

name: Mastery - This Formation is Cursed
description: Investigate the cursed farm you passed earlier with every curse imaginable.
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "The Cursed Farmer" completed
restrictions_text:
A chicken takes up a slot in the formation. Champions adjacent to the Chicken must have at least one ability score that is 18 or higher.
A mad cow takes up a slot  in the formation. Champions adjacent to the Cow must have a base attack speed higher than 5 seconds.
All slots in the formation are cursed, except for one. Champions placed in cursed slots cannot attack with their base attacks or use their ultimate abilities.

name: Mastery - The Maddest Wizards
description: Investigate the odd imp-infested tower you passed earlier while being constantly harassed by Wizards.
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "The Mad Wizard" completed
restrictions_text:
An Imp takes up a slot in the formation.
Champions placed adjacent to the Imp must be Evil and may not have the Speed role.
Every 200 areas, the Champions in the front-most and rear-most formation slots are removed from the formation.
Champions can not otherwise be removed nor swapped out of the formation after they are added.
With each non-boss wave, a Ragged Mad Wizard Clone also spawns and attacks the formation. Clones do not drop gold nor count for quest progress when defeated.
When a Clone is defeated, it:
- Morphs into Pure Energy which cannot be attacked or killed. Pure Energy does not block spawns from occurring.
- Lowers the damage of all Champions in the formation by 99%, stacking multiplicatively up to 50 times. This effect is only reset when a new boss area is completed.

name: Mastery - The Longest Night
description: Every night, uber zombies are attacking a village, and your forest friends are not being very helpful.
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "Terror in the Dark" completed
restrictions_text:
Two friendly animals (a Raccoon and a Beaver) join the formation.
Champions adjacent to the Raccoon must be a core Champion or a Ranger, Druid, or Barbarian.
Champions adjacent to the Beaver attack 4x slower.
Additional Uber Relentless Undead monsters spawn and attack your formation.
When they are killed, Uber Relentless Undead don't disappear. Instead, after 5 seconds, they get back up and start attacking again.
If an Uber Relentless Undead attacks a Champion, that Champion is instantly defeated.

name: Mastery - The Evil Within
description: A local mine needs your help to solve a goblin problem, but you've got bigger problems in your formation.
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "Unearthed Evil" completed
restrictions_text:
Monsters spawn continuously, but only 25% of monsters drop any gold, quest items, or count toward quest progress.
Additional shadow monsters attack your formation. They're invisible and cannot be damaged until they reach you, then they are revealed and can be damaged. They move quickly and don't block spawns. Each of their attacks deal 100% of the target Champion's max health. They can be knocked back while invisible (though you can't see it).
Evil Champions must make up at least half of your formation. If not, the damage of all Champions is reduced to 0.
Each Evil Champion in the formation emanates waves of evil which reduce the damage of all adjacent Champions by 33%, stacking additively, and randomly damage one adjacent Champion for 10% of their max health every 3 seconds.

description: Attempt to get on the good side of some red-robed academic wizards.
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "Seeking Allies" completed
restrictions_text:
Three Red Wizards join the formation. An Abjurer at the front, an Illusionist in the top left corner, and a Transmuter in the bottom left corner.
Champions placed between the Abjurer and another Red Wizard must be either dwarves or Small Champions (Small Champions are fairy, gnome, goblin, halfling, kender, kobold, and plasmoid Champions.)
Champions placed between the Illusionist and another Red Wizard must have a magic base attack.
Champions placed between the Transmuter and another Red Wizard must have a total ability score of 78 or lower.
These restrictions persist even if any or all of the Red Wizards are defeated.

name: Mastery - Monkey Business
description: Explore Port Nyanzaru while right smack in the middle of the local intrigue.
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "Exploring Port Nyanzaru" completed
restrictions_text:
Three citizens take up slots in the formation. They're happy with their slots and do not move around every 25 areas.
Topknot Guy requires all adjacent Champions must have a base attack cooldown of 5s or higher.
White Scarf Guy requires all adjacent Champions must have a WIS score of 16 or higher.
Balding Guy requires all adjacent Champions must have a melee base attack.
2-4 Undead Flying Monkeys spawn randomly alongside normal non-boss waves. They toss monkey skulls at random Champions in the formation dealing 5% of the target Champion's max health per hit. They do not drop gold nor count toward quest progress.

name: Mastery - Jockeying for Position
description: Battle against a steady flow of dinosaurs as you prepare for a trek into the jungle.
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "Running of the Saurs" completed
restrictions_text:
You may only have 3 Champions in the formation that do not have the Speed role. If you have more than that, the damage of all Champions is set to 0.
Each Champion may only be used for 100 areas times their bench seat number. Once a Champion has been in the formation for more than that number of areas, they're no longer allowed to be used until the adventure is reset.
You must complete this adventure within 60 minutes of starting it
An armored Racing Dinosaur takes up the front-most slot in the formation. It is completely invulnerable.

name: Mastery - Brain Frog
description: Make your way into the spooky and deadly jungles of Chult with the help of two ill-informed guides.
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "The Templar's Camp" completed
restrictions_text:
A hit-based Spectre appears randomly, slowly moving towards your formation and, if it reaches your formation and hits a Champion, it one-shots your entire formation before disappearing. The Spectre is immune to knockback and stuns.
All enemies, aside from the Spectre, deal 100% more damage and move 50% faster for each enemy alive.
The ill informed guide from the second variant has a cousin, and they're both insisting on guiding your party through this harrowing experience.
The top-most guide is extremely chatty and distracting. Champions adjacent to them must have a CHA score of 15 or higher to ignore their ill-timed advice.
The bottom-most guide continuously leads Champions through poison clouds. Champions adjacent to them must have a CON score of 15 or higher to resist the noxious vapors.

restrictions_text:

name: Mastery - Force Grey Takes Sides
description: Once again, patrol the streets of Waterdeep with Force Grey.
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "A Mysterious Summons" completed
restrictions_text:
All the Force Grey Champions start in the formation. They can be moved, but not removed.
You can't add any other Champions with the DPS role.
Two of Vajra's Stone Golems accompany you on this adventure.
All Champions join the faction war. All Champions in even bench seats support the Zhentarim and all Champions in odd bench seats support the Xanathar.
Champions supporting the Xanathar deal no damage to Xanathar enemies.
Champions supporting the Zhentarim deal no damage to Zhentarim enemies.
Champions supporting one faction deal 0 damage if they are adjacent to 2 or more Champions supporting the opposite faction.
Fire breath potions can't be used during the adventure, and click damage has no effect after area 100.

name: Mastery - Wizened Waterdeep Walkabout
description: Is it wise to escort a mysterious noble through a dangerous night out in Waterdeep?
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "Building Trust" completed
restrictions_text:
No two Champions in the formation can share the same WIS score. If they do, the damage of all Champions is set to 0.
Only Champions with an INT score of 12 or higher may be used.
A fancy red panda in a top hat riding a unicycle (don't ask) takes up a slot in the formation. You must have at least one core or evergreen Champion adjacent to the red panda, or else the damage of all Champions is set to 0.

name: Mastery - Beep Boop Boom
description: Protect the hidden lords of Waterdeep from a very scary cannon alongside Nordom and R0AM.
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "The Dinner Party" completed
restrictions_text:
Nordom starts in the formation and can be moved but not removed. He also can not be placed in the front-most column of the formation.
R0AM starts in the formation as an escort.
Whenever Nordom is moved, R0AM also moves to take up the slot opposite to Nordom.
Champions placed within one column of Nordom must have a CHA score of 16 or higher. If they do not, the damage of all Champions is set to 0.
Aside from Nordom, Champions placed within one column of R0AM must have a DEX score of 16 or higher. If they do not, the damage of all Champions is set to 0.
In all boss areas, an additional Drunken Sailor boss spawns alongside the normal boss. This boss must also be defeated to continue. The Drunken Sailor moves 100% faster, has 10 armored health, and is riding a cannon that one-shots any Champion it hits.

name: Mastery - The Stench of Evil
description: Help Volothamp Geddarm with a small task while holding your nose in more ways than one.
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "The Botched Kidnapping" completed
restrictions_text:
A Cultist of Asmodeus takes up a slot in the formation. Champions adjacent to the Cultist must count as Evil, or else the damage of all Champions is set to 0.
A Skunk takes up a slot in the formation. Champions adjacent to the Skunk must count as a Non-Standard species, or else the damage of all Champions is set to 0.
1-2 Black Wyrmlings spawn with each wave in every area, including boss areas. They attack random Champions with fireballs, but do not drop gold or count towards quest progress.
A Crazed Owlbear with 5 armor spawns in every boss area and must be defeated to progress. All Champions except the one in the slot between the Cultist and the Skunk are stunned until it is defeated. Champions who are stunned can not be healed.

name: Mastery - I Have Darkvision
description: Clear out your new Waterdeep digs with your most insufferable Champions.
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "Trollskull Manor" completed
restrictions_text:
Interior areas of Trollskull Manor are shrouded in darkness.
The darkness covers the right half of the screen.
Champions who are of a species with darkvision can attack enemies when they are in the darkness. Species that have darkvision include Aasimar, Dhampir, Doppelganger, Dragonborn, Dwarf, Eladrin, Elf, Gensai, Gnome, Goblin, Half-Elf, Half-Orc, Kobold, Plasmoid, Tabaxi, Thri-kreen, Tiefling, Triton, and Yuan-ti.
In areas ending in a 0, a Blockade and a Goblin appear. The boss is invulnerable until the Blockade and Goblin are taken out. When the Goblin is defeated, he runs off the screen instead of disappearing.
In areas ending in a 5, a Coldlight Walker appears and the darkness is temporarily removed while it's alive. All Champions with darkvision are blinded and stunned until it is defeated, and it must be defeated in order to progress.
Some animated objects are lost and need help finding their proper place in the manor. They take up slots in the formation.

restrictions_text:
You may only use Champions who are Warlocks, Clerics, or Paladins, or have the Hunter role.

Champions from the same original event year cannot be placed adjacent to each other in the formation. If they are, the damage of all Champions is set to 0. All core and evergreen Champions count as being from the same "event" year.
1-2 imps spawn with each wave. They do not count for quest progress and drop no gold.

restrictions_text:
Amrik Vanthampur (under arrest) takes up the null formation spot in the center of the formation.
Only Event Champions who are Human or Evil can be used.
A Doppelganger joins the formation in the backmost slot and takes on the appearance of the Champion in the front-most center formation slot.
The damage of all Champions not being mimicked by the Doppelganger is set to 0.
All Champions in the formation must have at least one of the following attributes in common with the Champion being mimicked by the Doppelganger: an ability score, species, class, or full alignment (ie. Chaotic Good). If they don't, the damage of all Champions is set to 0.

name: Mastery - Mad Dash
description: Head to Candlekeep with the Flaming Fist and a precious artifact, but watch your step!
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "Difficult Terrain" completed
restrictions_text:
Two members of the Flaming Fist escort a floating Time Gate piece and the Champions to Candlekeep 
Champions adjacent to the Time Gate Piece must all be Event Champions from different event years. If not, the damage of all Champions is set to 0.
1-2 Madcaps spawn with each wave in all areas. These enemies move 200% faster as they charge toward the Champions. They do not drop gold or count toward quest progress. When a Madcap attacks a Champion, 2 additional Madcaps spawn. While any Madcaps are alive, all other enemies can not be damaged.
Only Champions adjacent to a living member of the Flaming Fist can deal damage to the Madcaps. If both the Flaming Fists die, the Madcaps can no longer be damaged.

name: Mastery - What A Disaster!
description: Discover the secrets of Elturel while navigating a seemingly never-ending series of disasters.
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "Elturel Has Fallen" completed
restrictions_text:
You may only use Champions whose combined STR, DEX, and CON score are 40 or higher.
Champions may not be placed adjacent to another Champion whose highest scoring (including ties) ability stat is the same as their own. If they are, the damage of all Champions is set to 0.
In every area, one of three disasters befalls the party:
- An earthquake strikes. Immediately upon entering the area, all Champions take 75% of their max health as damage and are stunned for 15 seconds. The stun can be avoided with a DEX save.
- A hailstorm strikes. Three hailstones fall from the sky and strike a random Champion every second, dealing 90% of their max health. The damage can be reduced with a STR save.
- The party's rations go bad. All Champions immediately have their ultimate attacks go on cooldown. The cooldown period can be reduced with a CON save.

- Only one Champion of each class can be included in the formation at any time. Multiclass Champions count for all of their classes. Xerophon does not have a class for this variant.

After area 10, Champions can only deal damage while Xerophon is imitating an enemy with their Perfect Imitation ultimate attack.
Champions can't be removed from the formation once they have been added.
Every 50 areas, a random Champion that matches the highest number of Xerophon's specialization choices is removed from the formation and can not be used again in the adventure. In the case of a tie, a random tied Champion is picked. If you have not chosen any spec choices for Xerophon, a random Champion is picked. Xerophon themself is never removed.
Fire breath potions can't be used during the adventure, and click damage has no effect after area 100.

description: Enter Icewind Dale and get lost in the storm with a particular set of Champions
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "The Giant's Bane Tavern" completed
restrictions_text:
You must have Volothamp "Volo" Geddarm unlocked in order to start this variant.
Volothamp "Volo" Geddarm starts in the formation. He can not be removed.
Only Volo, Champions with the Hunter role, Champions from the Absolute Adversaries, or Champions with a Magic attack can be used.
Starting at area 50, you must use a Champion from bench seats 3, 6, and 12. If you do not, the damage of all Champions is set to 0.
Champions from seats 3, 6, and 12 must be placed adjacent to Volo. If they are not, the damage of all Champions is set to 0.
Three Well-Dressed Bandits appear before the first wave of each boss area. They must be defeated before any other enemies can take damage. One of the bandits has hits-based health, one has armor-based health, and one has crit-based health.

Wulfgar starts in the formation and can not be removed or swapped out.
Only Champions from the Companions of the Hall affiliation can deal damage.
Chadwick joined the formation. He's still experimenting with some spell scrolls, so Champions adjacent to Chadwick deal 0 damage to normal enemies and bosses.
Three random Illusory Enemies from other campaigns appear with the first wave of each area. They do not drop gold nor count toward quest progress, but in addition to the normal quest, you must also defeat these enemies in order to advance. Only Champions adjacent to Chadwick can deal damage to Illusory Enemies.

name: Mastery - Oh The Hew Maan-ity
description: Head to Termalaine and help Hew Maan with an overrun gem mine!
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "Civilization" completed
restrictions_text:
Hew Maan starts in the formation and can be moved but not removed.
Champions adjacent to Hew Maan must belong to an affiliation and have a WIS score of 12 or higher. If this requirement is not met, the damage of all Champions is set to 0.
Champions NOT adjacent to Hew Maan must be Unaffiliated and have a DEX score of 14 or higher. If this requirement is not met, the damage of all Champions is set to 0.
1-2 Winter Wolves appear with each non-boss wave. They don't drop gold, nor do they count towards quest progress. Only Champions adjacent to Hew Maan can damage these enemies.
One Winter Wolf Alpha appears at the start of each boss area. They must be defeated in order to progress. Only Champions NOT adjacent to Hew Maan can damage this enemy.

name: Mastery - Havi's Choosy Chapbook Chill
description: Explore a rumor about invisible dwarves in Caer-Konig while Havilar reads a cursed Chapbook.
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "Dwarven Rumors" completed
restrictions_text:
Havilar starts in the formation. She *can* be removed or swapped out.
An evil floating chapbook takes up a slot in the formation. Champions adjacent to the book must meet the following requirements:
1. STR 14+
2. DEX 14+
3. CON 14+
4. CHA 14+
While Havilar is in the formation, the book's requirements are lessened to 11 based on the Imp companion(s) she has chosen. Mot lessens the STR requirement. Dembo lessens the DEX requirement. Olla lessens the CON requirement. Bosh lessens the CHA requirement.
It's snowing heavily in all outdoor areas.
Only Champions with a Magic base attack and WIS as their highest ability score can deal damage.

restrictions_text:
Nat and Gale the Miniature Giant Seahorse take up slots in the formation
They must be distracted by more familiar friends or else the damage of your formation will suffer.
If you have fewer than 17 familiars assigned to your formation, the damage of all Champions is reduced by 99.9% for each unassigned familiar.
If you have fewer than 11 familiars assigned to your formation, the damage of all Champions is set to 0.
Only Champions with a CHA score of 13 or higher may be used.
No two adjacent Champions in the formation may have a DEX score that is within one. If they do, the damage of all Champions is set to 0.

requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "Thieves of the Coven" completed
restrictions_text:

Sowpig appears in the second wave of every boss area with 15 armored health. She is the only enemy in the adventure that drops gold.
Two slots in the formation are taken up by patrons. The patrons occupying these slots change every 400 areas. 
Champions placed in slots adjacent to each patron must fulfill that patron's restrictions. If they do not, the damage of all Champions is set to 0.
Champions from the same event year may not be placed adjacent to each other. For the purposes of this restriction, non-event Champions all count as being from the same year. If this restriction is not followed, the damage of all Champions is set to 0.

restrictions_text:

A Gas Bubble takes up a slot in the formation. Champions adjacent to the Gas Bubble attack 3x slower. They're being extra careful to try not to pop it. If the Gas Bubble is killed by an enemy, it pops and instantly kills all adjacent Champions.
The weather in all areas that normally have no weather is set to Foggy. In Fog, Champions have a chance to miss with their attacks based on their WIS score.
A single invincible spider spawns after the first wave in every non-boss area. It moves half as fast as normal monsters, but one-shots Champions it attacks.

description: Help Laeral Silverhand understand a new threat to Waterdeep while keeping Squiddly's new rocket from exploding
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "Seeds of Destruction" completed
restrictions_text:
You may only use Elf or Half-Elf Champions in the front two columns.
You may only use Champions with the Speed role in the back column.
Squiddly riding a rocket joins the formation.
If you take more than 20 seconds to complete an area, Squiddly's rocket explodes and you immediately fail the area (Squiddly is fine; he has a backup rocket in the previous area).
Fire breath potions can't be used during the adventure, and click damage has no effect after area 100.

name: Mastery - Squiddly Versus The Space Clowns
description: Get to the Dock Ward before the city is overrun and your Champions are burnt to a crisp.
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "The Evacuation of Waterdeep" completed
restrictions_text:
Squiddly riding a rocket joins the formation.
Squiddly has figured out his fuse issues from the previous Mastery Variant and his rocket will not explode if you take too long to complete an area. Instead, the blast from the rocket damages Champions in the columns behind him for 25% of their max health every 5 seconds.
Only Champions with a WIS score of 12 or lower can be placed in the columns behind Squiddly, because... why would you stand there?
If Squiddly is defeated, his rocket explodes, instantly killing all the Champions in the columns behind him.
One Red Wizard Transmuter spawns with each wave. When it's defeated, it polymorphs into a Space Clown. The Space Clown has 5 hits-based health, moves 200% faster, and ignores all taunt abilities. This is why kids are afraid of clowns.

name: Mastery - Pie in the Sky
description: Set sail into Wildspace while watching for falling pies.
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "Who Lurks Below?" completed
restrictions_text:
Squiddly riding a rocket joins the formation. His rocket is looking a little rickety, and he needs some strong folks to help him hold it together.
Only Champions with a STR score of 15 or higher can be placed adjacent to Squiddly 
Only Champions with a CHA score of 15 or higher can be placed non-adjacent to Squiddly
The formation must have a combined INT score of 125 or higher, or else the damage of all Champions is set to 0.
A Space Clown Ringmaster spawns in each boss area.
As soon as it has spawned, and until it is defeated, the Space Clown Ringmaster causes giant Cream Pies to fall on the entire formation every 5 seconds, dealing 50% of each Champion's max health and having a chance to stun them for 30 seconds. Each Champion has a chance to take half damage and resist the stun based on their CON score.

name: Mastery - Magic Missiles at the Darkness
description: Investigate a trading post nestled in an asteroid while Squiddly goes crazy with power.
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "Xanathaaaaaaar!" completed
restrictions_text:
Squiddly is tinkering with miniature rockets and fires one at a random Shadar-Kai enemy every 20 seconds.
Champions behind the rocket must be a Fighter or have a WIS score of 13 or higher. 
Champions beside or in front of the rocket must be a Paladin or have a CHA score of 18 or higher. 
For each Fighter in the formation, Squiddly deals 15% of his target's max health with each hit, stacking additively. 
For each Champion with a WIS of 13 or higher in the formation, Squiddly attacks 3 seconds faster, stacking additively. Caps at an 18 second reduction.
For each Paladin in the formation, Squiddly's rocket slows enemies it hits by 10%, stacking additively. Multiple slows do not stack, but the slow lasts until the enemy is defeated.
For each Champion with a CHA score of 18 or higher in the formation, Squiddly has a 15% chance to fire a second rocket with each attack. Stacks additively. Caps at 100%.
1-2 Shadar-Kai spawn with each wave, including in boss areas. The Shadar-Kai are invulnerable to all attacks except Squiddly's rockets. Shadar-Kai instantly kill any Champions they attack.
Every 250 areas, the Shadar-Kai move 25% faster, stacking multiplicatively.
Familiars are wearing fancy hats. Squiddly is also wearing a fancy hat. Why? Because.

name: Mastery - Claws & Jaws
description: Scavenge your way through Wildspace with Squiddly while avoiding a feeding frenzy.
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "No One Can Hear You Scream" completed
restrictions_text:
Squiddly joins the formation on a Rocket. He's given up on firing mini rockets for the time being, and the stray cat from the previous variant sits near him to provide emotional support.
Only Champions adjacent to the stray cat can deal damage
Only Champions with a Magic base attack can be placed in the first three columns of the formation
1-2 Gray Scavvers spawn with each non-boss wave. When a Gray Scavver spawns it attempts to stun a random Champion for 10 seconds, and then repeats the stun every 3 seconds while it remains undefeated.
The stun can be avoided by knowing that sharks very rarely attack people. Every point of WIS over 10 grants a 10% chance to avoid the stun, stacking additively.
If at any point more than 6 Champions are stunned, all Gray Scavvers go into a feeding frenzy and gain 400% move speed and deal 10% of their target's max health with each hit. This effect ends immediately once less than 6 Champions are stunned.

For the first 100 areas, you may use Lawful or Good champions. Every 100 areas, this restriction changes:

description: Return to the Tomb of Annihilation (a couple of times) to stop Acererak from assembling a villainous super team!
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "The Beginning is the End" completed
restrictions_text:
Every 10 minutes of real time, all Champions are removed from the formation and can't be used for the rest of the adventure. The timer only restarts when a Champion is added an empty formation.
Once a Champion has been added to the formation, they may not be removed or swapped out.
Once there are 2 Speed Champions in your formation, you may not add any more.
Fire breath potions can't be used during the adventure, and click damage has no effect after area 100.

name: Mastery - The Four Pillars
description: WWWW JJJJ HHHH HHHH?
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "The End is the Beginning" completed
restrictions_text:
Four slots in the formation have glowing, sparking, or pulsing pillars in them.
Each Champion in a slot with a glowing pillar must count as more than one species. If they don't, the damage of all Champions is set to 0.
Each Champion in a slot with a sparking pillar must count as more than one alignment. If they don't, the damage of all Champions is set to 0.
Each Champion in a slot with a pulsing pillar must count as more than one class. If they don't, the damage of all Champions is set to 0.
All Champions with a positional formation ability must be adjacent to at least one Champion without a positional formation ability. If they're not, the damage of all Champions is set to 0.

name: Mastery - Finding Your Balance
description: Explore Sigil and learn more about the predicament you find yourself in.
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "Welcome to Sigil" completed
restrictions_text:
Your formation MUST contain ONLY one Champion of each alignment. If it does not, the damage of all Champions is set to 0. 
If you are running this variant with Mirt enabled, three slots in the formation are taken up by Fools.
The slot opposite to the forced empty slot in the formation is marked as "Unbalanced".
In each boss area, either a Herald of the Dust boss or a Sivak Draconian boss spawns alongside the boss, and must also be defeated to continue.
Only Good Champions can deal damage to the additional Draconian boss.
Only the Champion in the Unbalanced formation slot can deal damage to the additional Herald of the Dust boss.

name: Mastery - The Good, the Bad, and the Weird
description: Elude the Harmonium Peacekeepers while you try to stock up on rations and gear.
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "Fast Food" completed
restrictions_text:
Champions in the top of each column must be Chaotic and cannot be Evil.
Champions in the bottom of each column must be Evil and cannot be Chaotic.
In even-numbered areas (including boss areas), 1-2 Harmonium Peacekeepers spawn with each wave. Other enemies cannot be damaged while Harmonium Peacekeepers are alive. Only Champions who are of a Good alignment can damage Harmonium Peacekeepers.
In odd-numbered areas (including boss areas), 1-2 Red Wizards spawn with each wave. Other enemies cannot be damaged while Red Wizards are alive. Only Champions with an INT score of 14 or higher can damage Red Wizards.

name: Mastery - Morte's Entourage
description: The Champions join Morte in the high rollers room at the Fortune's Wheel casino, at least for a little while.
requirements_text: All ten campaigns unlocked and all three variants of "The Fortune's Wheel" completed
restrictions_text:
Morte starts in the formation. He can be moved, but not removed.
You may not use Champions with the Gold Find role.
You may only use Chaotic Good Champions in formation slots adjacent to Morte, and you may NOT use Chaotic Good Champions in any other slots (except for Morte himself). If this restriction is not followed, the damage of all Champions is set to 0.
Only Chaotic Good Champions can deal damage.
Once a Chaotic Good Champion is added to the formation they can not be removed.
You may only manually add a max of 3 Chaotic Good Champions to the formation excluding Morte at a time.
The Chaotic Good Champions placed next to Morte have a falling out with him every 500 areas and are removed from the formation.
The total WIS score of the Champions in the formation who are not adjacent to Morte must be at least 95. If not, the damage of all Champions is set to 0.
Click damage is disabled after area 50.
Fire breath potions can't be used during the adventure.

requirements_text: Must have completed "Friends of a Feather"
restrictions_text:
Strongheart starts in the formation. He can be moved, but not removed.
You may only use Good Champions.
After area 50, Champions deal 1 damage with normal attacks until any Champion lands a Critical Hit in the current area.
When a Champion deals a Critical Hit, that Champion takes damage equal to 20% of their maximum health.
Fire breath potions can't be used during the adventure, and click damage has no effect after area 50.

name: An Affiliation Affair
description: Strongheart explores the Feywild with an old friend and a few groups of guides.
requirements_text: Must have completed "Friends of a Feather"
restrictions_text:
Strongheart starts in the formation. He can be moved, but not removed.
Only Strongheart and Champions from the affiliation(s) with the most members in the formation can deal damage.
Once the formation has 3 Champions from the same affiliation, you can't add any more Champions from that affiliation.

name: Free Play
description: Strongheart explores the Feywild with an old friend and a few helpful guides.
requirements_text: Must have completed "Friends of a Feather"
objectives_text: Free Play - Reset whenever you wish
restrictions_text: No restrictions

name: Double Standards
description: Havilar and Farideh get pulled into a black market investigation with twice the requirements.
restrictions_text: Havilar joins the formation. She can be moved, but not removed. You may only use Champions that are a Standard Species. Standard Species are Aasimar, Dragonborn, Dwarf, Elf, Gnome, Goliath, Halfling, Human, Orc, Tiefling, Half-Orc, and Half-Elf Quest requirements are doubled. Getting to Know Idle Champions: Some Speed Champions, like Havilar, increase the rate at which you progress in area quests. Use her and other Speed Champions to get through these increased requirements.

name: Chipping Away
description: Havilar and Farideh get pulled into a black market investigation while facing some armored foes.
restrictions_text:
Havilar joins the formation. She can be moved, but not removed.
You may only use Champions with an ability score total of 81 or more.
All enemies have 4 armored health if they don't already have segmented health.
Enemy speed and damage are increased by 100%.
All Champions' base attack cooldowns are increased by 3 seconds.

name: Charging Up
description: Havilar and Farideh get pulled into a black market investigation while facing foes that grow stronger before they engage.
restrictions_text:
Havilar joins the formation. She can be moved, but not removed.
You may only use Neutral Good, Chaotic Good, and/or Chaotic Neutral Champs.
Each enemy's damage increases by 100% for each second they are active before they attack, stacking multiplicatively.

description: Hank and his friends with a variety of low ability scores enjoy the Witchlight Carnival.

Once you have two Champions in the formation with a particular ability score total, you may not add any more Champions with that particular ability score total. Getting to Know Idle Champions: Many variants restrict Champions based on their ability scores. By collecting a bunch of Champions, you'll have more choices in these restrictive variants.

name: One Hit Wonders
description: Hank and his friends enjoy the Witchlight Carnival while facing particularly deadly enemies.
restrictions_text:
Hank joins the formation. He can be moved, but not removed.
You may only use Champions that are 30 years old or younger. Additionally, you may use Rosie and/or Gromma.
All enemies in a wave spawn at the same time.
Enemies with melee attacks automatically defeat Champions they deal damage to.

name: Crossover Episode
description: Hank and ALL of his friends enjoy the Witchlight Carnival thanks to the generosity of a 'friendly' pixie.
restrictions_text:
Hank joins the formation. He can be moved, but not removed.
You may only use Good Champions.
Assorted friends join the formation.
At the start of each Boss area, Venger arrives on his nightmare as an additional boss that must be defeated.

name: Uneclipsed
description: Kas seeks new purpose in unlife, with a little help from his supporting friends.
restrictions_text: Kas joins the formation. He can be moved, but not removed. You may not use any other Champions that have the DPS role. One of Kas's soldiers joins the formation. Only Evil Champions next to the soldier can deal damage with their base attacks. Getting to Know Idle Champions: Champions with the DPS role are your main damage dealers. Choose and position your Champions well to make the most out of your party's main damage dealer!

name: Who's the Boss?
description: Kas seeks new purpose in unlife, while facing some additional bosses.
restrictions_text:
Kas joins the formation. He can be moved, but not removed.
Boss health, damage, and speed are increased by 100%.
A boss enemy spawns at the start of the first wave of each non-boss area. These extra bosses do not drop gold or loot bags, or count toward quest progress
Two of Kas's soldiers join the formation. Only Evil Champions next to either soldier can deal damage with their base attacks.

name: No Rest for the Wicked
description: Kas seeks new purpose in unlife, with a little help from his restless friends.
restrictions_text:
Kas joins the formation. He can be moved, but not removed.
Champions don't recover health when moving to a new area. 
Champions resurrect at half health when changing areas instead of full health.
At the start of each area, Champions take damage equal to 30% of their max health.
Three of Kas's soldiers join the formation. Only Evil Champions next to either soldier can deal damage with their base attacks.

description: Nordom and friends investigate a curious case of vanishing modrons.
restrictions_text: No restrictions

name: Gone Missing
description: Nordom and friends investigate a curious case of vanishing modrons and vanishing Champions.
restrictions_text: Nordom joins the formation. He can be moved, but not removed. Click damage only deals damage for the first 25 areas. Fire breath potions can't be used during the adventure. Once a Champion is placed in the formation they can not be swapped or removed Every 50 areas, 20% of the Champions are removed and locked for the remainder of the adventure. Nordom is immune to this effect. Getting to Know Idle Champions: Once you've unlocked at least two Champions in each bench slot, you can attempt to unlock a second party and run two sets of Champions at the same time! This variant gives you a little practice on how to Split the Party.

name: Clockwork Clash
description: Nordom and friends investigate a curious case of aggressive and armored modrons.
restrictions_text:
Nordom joins the formation. He can be moved, but not removed.
Only one Champion of each species can be included in the formation at any time. Champions with multiple species count for all of their species.
Non-boss Construct enemies without segmented health have 4 segmented health instead of their normal health
1-2 Modrons spawn with each wave. They don't drop gold nor count towards quest progress.

name: All Roads Lead to R04M
description: Nordom, R04M, and friends investigate a curious case of vanishing modrons.
restrictions_text:
Nordom joins the formation. He can be moved, but not removed.
You may only use Champions with a total ability score of 82 or higher.
R04M starts in the formation. Champions next to R04M have a +2 bonus to all ability scores, but it's too late to help with the variant restriction.

name: Free Play
description: Nordom and friends investigate a curious case of vanishing modrons.

name: Legacy
description: Duke Ravengard and allies embark on a hellish rescue mission.
restrictions_text: No restrictions

name: Rise of a Legacy
description: Duke Ravengard and a select group of allies embark on a hellish rescue mission.
restrictions_text: Duke Ravengard starts in the formation. He can be moved, but not removed. You may only use Champions with a Melee base attack. After you complete area 50 for the first time, you can't remove Champions from the formation. When you complete this variant, any Champions in the formation will be unavailable in the Burden of Legacy or End of a Legacy variants. Each Patron variant has its own list of unavailable Champions. Fire breath potions can't be used during the adventure, and click damage has no effect after area 100. Getting to Know Idle Champions: A Champion's attack is categorized as a Melee, Ranged, and/or a Magic attack. Some Variants and Champion abilities require a Champion to have a specific type of attack!

name: Burden of Legacy
description: Duke Ravengard and a dwindling supply of allies embark on a hellish rescue mission.
restrictions_text: Duke Ravengard starts in the formation. He can be moved, but not removed. You may only use Champions with a Melee base attack. You also can't use any Champions that you used to finish variant 1 other than Duke Ravengard. After area 10, all enemies spawn with an extra 10 armored hit points which must be destroyed before their regular hit points appear. When an enemy is knocked back, these armored hit points are immediately removed, revealing its normal health bar. After you complete area 50 for the first time, you can't remove Champions from the formation. When you complete this variant, any Champions in the formation will be unavailable in the End of a Legacy variant. Each Patron variant has its own list of unavailable Champions. Fire breath potions can't be used during the adventure, and click damage has no effect after area 100.

name: End of a Legacy
description: Duke Ravengard and a pitiful handful of allies embark on a hellish rescue mission.
restrictions_text:
Duke Ravengard starts in the formation. He can be moved, but not removed.
You may only use Champions with a Melee base attack. You also can't use any Champions that you used to finish variant 1 and 2 other than Duke Ravengard.
After area 10, enemies spawn with a special shield which must be destroyed before their regular hit points appear. To destroy a special shield, an enemy must be hit with a critical hit.
Fire breath potions can't be used during the adventure, and click damage has no effect after area 100.

name: Free Play
description: Duke Ravengard and allies embark on a hellish rescue mission.

All Enemies move 100% faster and their base attack cooldowns are reduced by 50%.

description: Spurt wants to be a pirate, and he keeps droning on about it.

Spurt starts in the formation. He can be moved, but not removed.
You may only use Champions with both a Dexterity and Charisma of 13 or higher.
Two Hellwasps join the formation. They just get in the way.

description: Baeloth lends his experience to a charity fundraiser for refugees.

name: Power Word Pain
description: Baeloth lends his experience to a charity fundraiser for refugees while his companions suffer.
restrictions_text: Baeloth joins the formation. He can't be moved or removed. Only Baeloth and the Champions in the columns ahead and behind him can deal damage with their base attacks. Each time a Champion other than Baeloth deals damage with their base attack, they take damage equal to 5% of their max health. Each time a Champion other than Baeloth uses their ultimate, they take damage equal to 50% of their max health. Champions don't recover health when moving to a new area. Champions resurrect at half health when changing areas instead of full health. Getting to Know Idle Champions: Some Champions like Baeloth can prevent a Champion from dying. This often provides your formation with the final push you need to succeed!

name: Power Word Stun
description: Baeloth lends his experience to a charity fundraiser for refugees while his companions are incapacitated.
restrictions_text:
Baeloth joins the formation. He can be moved, but not removed.
You may only use Champions with the Gold Find, Hunter, or DPS role.
After area 50, one Champion is stunned in each area. The Champion in seat 1 is stunned first, advancing by bench order in each area. Baeloth's seat is skipped, and this resets after seat 12.
Champions in stunned seats cannot be moved or removed from the formation.

name: Power Word Kill
description: Baeloth lends his experience to a charity fundraiser for refugees while his companions drop like flies.
restrictions_text:
Baeloth joins the formation. He can be moved, but not removed.
After area 50, a random Champion other than Baeloth takes damage equal to 100% of their max health every 10 seconds.

name: Three Wolf Moon
description: Shadowheart and allies chase after a stolen relic to another world while being chased by wolves.
restrictions_text: Shadowheart joins the formation. She can be moved, but not removed. In non-boss areas, 3 Wolves spawn with each wave. They don't drop gold nor count towards quest progress. These Wolves are armored enemies that move 200% faster and deal 400% more damage. Champions don't recover health when moving to a new area. Champions resurrect at half health when changing areas instead of full health. Getting to Know Idle Champions: Champions with the Healing role let other heroes recover health or gain temporary health that can go above normal maximums.

name: Waxing or Waning
description: Shadowheart and her agile allies chase after a stolen relic to another world.
restrictions_text:
Shadowheart joins the formation. She can be moved, but not removed.
You may only use Champions with a Dexterity of 14 or higher.
If the formation includes an Evil Champion, you may not add Good Champions.
If the formation includes a Good Champion, you may not add Evil Champions.
Champions don't recover health when moving to a new area.
Champions resurrect at half health when changing areas instead of full health.

name: Can't Cast a Shadow Without Some Light
description: Shadowheart and her clumsy allies chase after a stolen relic to another world.
restrictions_text:
Shadowheart joins the formation. She can be moved, but not removed.
Other than Shadowheart, you may only use Champions with a Dexterity of 13 or lower.
A Torch joins the formation and bathes all adjacent formation slots in bright Light. Formation slots not adjacent to the torch are cast into Shadow.
Champions in the Light take 5% of their max health as damage every second and can not deal damage with their base attacks.
Champions in the Shadow have their damage boosted by 1000% for each Champion that is in the Light, stacking multiplicatively.
Whenever Shadowheart changes her position in the formation, the torch occupies her previous position (and if she took the spot of another Champion, they are moved to where the torch was).
Champions don't recover health when moving to a new area. 
Champions resurrect at half health when changing areas instead of full health.

Some Champions and variant restrictions care about including or excluding them!

When you add a Champion to the formation, all other Champions that don't share a species with them are removed. Kalix remains in the formation.
Boss enemies without segmented health have 25 armored health.

Two Giant Fire Beetles join the formation. They just get in the way.

restrictions_text: No restrictions

name: Speedy Strikers
description: Barrowin and her fast attacking friends must save the people of Icewind Dale from the Cult of the Dragon!
restrictions_text: Barrowin starts in the formation. She can be moved, but not removed. You may only use Champions with a base attack cooldown of 4.6 seconds or less. Every time a Champion kills an enemy, all other enemies have their move speed and damage done increased by 10%, stacking multiplicatively up to 25 times and resetting when changing areas. Getting to know Idle Champions: After every base attack, Champions must wait an amount of time equal to their base attack cooldown before they can make another base attack.

name: I Am The Law
description: Barrowin and her lawful friends must save the people of Icewind Dale from the Cult of the Dragon!
restrictions_text:
Barrowin starts in the formation. She can be moved, but not removed.
You may only use Lawful and/or Dwarf Champions.
An Overambitious City Guard joins the formation. He encourages Champions next to him to attack faster by reducing their base attack cooldown by 2 seconds.

name: Way Under
description: Barrowin and her small friends must save the people of Icewind Dale from the Cult of the Dragon!
restrictions_text:
Barrowin starts in the formation. She can be moved, but not removed.
You may only use dwarves and Small Champions. (Small Champions are fairy, gnome, goblin, halfling, kender, kobold, and plasmoid Champions.)
Enemies other than static bosses are increased in size by 50%.
Enemies without segmented health have 4 armored health.
Enemies (including those in boss areas) move 100% faster and deal a minimum amount of damage equal to 10% of the target's total health.

name: Free Play
description: Barrowin and friends must save the people of Icewind Dale from the Cult of the Dragon!

name: Kindred Spirits
description: Allies of Chult travel with Birdsong to investigate the haunted ruins of Mezro.
restrictions_text: No restrictions

name: Lonely Spirits
description: Allies of Chult travel with Birdsong to investigate the haunted ruins of Mezro before they're overwhelmed by the dead.
restrictions_text: Birdsong starts in the formation. She can be moved, but not removed. You may only use unaffiliated Champions and/or Champions that can be unlocked in the Tales campaign. Only Birdsong and Champions in the formation from the most represented alignment on the good/evil axis can deal damage. In non-boss areas, when an enemy is defeated they immediately turn into a Lonely Spirit, which can not be damaged and continues to advance upon and attack the formation. Lonely Spirits can only be removed by changing areas. Getting to Know Idle Champions: Some Champions have abilities that work best with a limited set of heroes. Choose your heroes well to make the most of these abilities!

name: Lawful Spirits
description: Allies of Chult travel with Birdsong to stop the party at the haunted ruins of Mezro from getting out of hand.
restrictions_text:
Birdsong starts in the formation. She can be moved, but not removed.
You may only use Lawful Champions.
1-2 Costumed Drunks spawn with each wave. They don't drop gold or count toward quest progress. Each time one of these enemies is defeated, they throw a mug at a random Champion in the formation, dealing 25% of the targeted Champions' max health.

name: Musical Spirits
description: Allies of Chult travel with Birdsong and her backup singers to investigate the haunted ruins of Mezro.
restrictions_text:
Birdsong starts in the formation. She can be moved, but not removed.
You may only use Bard Champions.
Three musical escorts take up slots in the formation. Champions next to one of these musicians attack 1 second faster due to their driving rhythm.

name: Free Play
description: Allies of Chult travel with Birdsong to investigate the haunted ruins of Mezro.

name: Making It Work
description: Tess leads the Fallbacks into Undermountain for a team-building adventure.
restrictions_text: No restrictions

name: Making It Smell
description: Tess leads the Fallbacks into Undermountain for a smelly team-building adventure.
restrictions_text: Tess starts in the formation. She can be moved, but not removed. You may only use Champions that are Rogues, have ranged attacks, are Unaffiliated, or belong to The Fallbacks affiliation. An Otyugh joins the formation. Champions next to the Otyugh deal no damage due to the stench. However, Fallbacks Champions still deal damage as they are already used to Uggie's pungent aroma. Getting to Know Idle Champions: When Uggie is assigned to Tess, the Otyugh deals BUD-based damage. BUD stands for Base Ultimate Damage, which is determined by the most damaging hit that anyone in your formation has recently done.

name: Role Models
description: Tess leads the Fallbacks into Undermountain for a diverse team-building adventure.
restrictions_text:
Tess starts in the formation. She can be moved, but not removed.
You may not add Champions to the formation if there are already two other Champions in the formation with the same role, not including the Support role.
1-2 Cakers attack with each wave because they are disappointed this variant has nothing to do with Cinnamon rolls. They don't drop gold nor count towards quest progress.

name: Team Up
description: Tess leads the Fallbacks and one other affiliation into Undermountain for a team-building adventure.
restrictions_text:
Tess starts in the formation. She can be moved, but not removed.
You may not use unaffiliated Champions.
Aside from the Fallbacks, you may only use one other affiliation. Once you have added a Champion from another affiliation to the formation, you may only add Champions from that affiliation or the Fallbacks.
In non-boss areas, each time an enemy is defeated, all damaged enemies are restored to full health and all existing and future enemies in the area gain 50% speed and 50% additional damage, stacking additively. These bonuses reset when changing areas.

name: Free Play
description: Tess leads the Fallbacks into Undermountain for a team-building adventure.
objectives_text: Free Play - Reset whenever you wish
restrictions_text: No restrictions

name: The Sleeper Awakens
description: The Champions must fight to save Waterdeep from the machinations of a hateful foe.
restrictions_text: No restrictions

name: Small Solutions for Big Problems
description: The Champions must fight to save Waterdeep from the machinations of a hateful foe and their red wizards allies!
restrictions_text:
After area 35, you may only use Small Champions due to the tight spaces. Small Champions are fairy, gnome, goblin, halfling, kender, kobold, and plasmoid Champions.
1-2 Red Wizards spawn with each wave. They don't drop gold nor count towards quest progress.

name: Story Mode
description: The Champions must fight to save Waterdeep from the machinations of a hateful foe with Laeral Silverhand!
restrictions_text:
Nine Champions start in the formation: Ezmerelda, Lae'zel, Dynaheir, Shadowheart, Catti-brie, Tess, Nordom, Havilar, and Strongheart. They can be moved, but not removed.
In Patron versions of this variant, if a Champion is not normally available for your current patron, that Champion deals 0 damage, and Champions adjacent to them deal 50% less damage, stacking additively
Laeral Silverhand joins the formation. She has health equal to the health of the Champion in the same column. In addition, she has a Reverse Taunt that makes monsters attack the main tank.
After area 1200, Laeral leaves the formation and you may use an additional Champion of your choice for the rest of the adventure.

name: Relentless Resolve
description: The Champions must fight to save Waterdeep from the machinations of a hateful foe and their relentless undead army.
restrictions_text:
1-2 Relentless Undead spawn with each wave. When they are defeated, Relentless Undead don't disappear. Instead, after 5 seconds, they get back up and start attacking again.
Each time you encounter the Area 50 boss, they respawn after they are killed (area/150) times before being counted as defeated. Each time they respawn, they gain 100% health, 100% damage, and their attack speed is reduced by 20%.

name: Free Play
description: The Champions must fight to save Waterdeep from the machinations of a hateful foe.
objectives_text: Free Play - Reset whenever you wish
restrictions_text: No restrictions

name: The Tale of the Titan's Fall
description: The Champions must fight to save Waterdeep from an ancient terror reforged.
restrictions_text: No restrictions

name: Race to Save Waterdeep
description: The Champions must fight to save Waterdeep from an ancient terror reforged as fast as they can!
restrictions_text:
You must complete area 1200 within 60 minutes of starting the objective.
Fire breath potions can't be used during the adventure, and click damage has no effect after area 5.

name: Story Mode Too
description: The Champions must fight to save Waterdeep with Vajra Safahr from an ancient terror reforged!
restrictions_text:
Nine Champions start in the formation: Hank, Spurt, Baeloth, Kalix, Kas, Duke Ravengard, Birdsong, Barrowin, and Melf. They can be moved, but not removed.
In Patron versions of this variant, if a Champion is not normally available for your current patron, that Champion deals 0 damage, and Champions adjacent to them deal 50% less damage, stacking additively.
Vajra Safahr joins the formation. She has health equal to the health of the Champion in the same column. In addition, she has a Reverse Taunt that makes monsters attack the main tank.
After area 1200, Vajra leaves the formation and you may use an additional Champion of your choice for the rest of the adventure.

name: Quick and the Squished
description: The Champions must fight to save Waterdeep from an ancient terror with a good arm for throwing rubble.
restrictions_text:
Every 120 seconds of real time play, a random Champion is struck back by a piece of building thrown by the Chardalyn Titan, removing them from the formation. They are unavailable for the rest of the adventure. The Titan will target Champions that aren't unlocked in the Tales of the Champions campaign first.
Champions can't otherwise be removed from the formation once they've been added.
The Hidden Lords of Waterdeep stealthily assist your party: When an area is completed, there is a 5% chance for each Champion in the formation (stacking additively) that the formation proceeds directly to the next boss area.
Fire breath potions can't be used during the adventure, and click damage has no effect after area 100.

name: Free Play
description: The Champions must fight to save Waterdeep from an ancient terror reforged.
objectives_text: Free Play - Reset whenever you wish
restrictions_text: No restrictions
